basic_info.description: Located in the picturesque Balboa Terrace neighborhood, this fully detached 3BD/2BA home is a charming example of Harold Stoner's whimsical Storybook architecture. Spanning 2,148 sqft, it blends historic details with elegant modern updates. A vaulted-ceiling living room with a stately fireplace welcomes you in, leading to a formal dining room and light-filled chef's kitchen with skylights, a waterfall island, Miele coffee station, wine cooler, and 6-burner range with pot filler. This is an entertainer's delight! The main level also features two bedrooms, a spa-like bath with heated flooring, and a serene primary with bay windows and dual closets, including a walk-in. Downstairs offers a flexible family room with built-ins, a third bedroom with adjoining den, a second full bath, laundry, and ample storage. A private yard and 2-car tandem garage rounds out this property. Enjoy nearby Stonestown Galleria, Ocean Ave, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, SFSU, Stern Grove, and Lake Merced, plus easy access to Muni, BART, 19th Ave, and HWY 280.
